_comment: Performance budget (PLAN Tahap 9). Bundle sizes are gzip KB (1024) of the production build; routes are what `npm run e2e:perf` measures on the mobile profile. API call counts are deterministic, so each route's ceiling is what it costs today: raise one only with the reason in the same change. LCP is NOT gated here (a lab number that moves with the machine); it stays in e2e/reports/BASELINE.md.

bundle._reason_totalGzipKB: 16 Nov 2026 (ADR-0046, ADR-0047): the new Keuangan and Kalender pages and the Client Portal write paths (kirim bukti transfer, tugas pasangan, foto sampul) add lazily loaded chunks only; the entry stays ~149 KB. Total was 698 KB of 700, so the ceiling moves to 720 to leave room for one more screen

marketing-beranda._reason: T-20261110-9 / ADR-0038: the price section reads the active public plans (GET /api/v1/public/plans) instead of hand-written numbers

wo-proyek-ringkasan._reason: ADR-0046 (16 Nov 2026): the Aktivitas tab became the Riwayat panel on Ringkasan, so Ringkasan now reads the 5 latest entries (GET /projects/{id}/activity?limit=5); the separate tab and its own call are gone
